verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a Bitwarden desktop application. Computer-side access appears only through the browser extension and the CLI (including `bw serve` exposing TOTP codes), which are separate surfaces, not a first-class desktop app. The Linux fingerprint comment does not establish one either.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
